newsitem.title: UK: NYNEX CableComms Q1 total rev up 43 pct.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX CableComms Q1 total rev up 43 pct.

text.p: NYNEX CableComms Group Plc on Wednesday said total revenue for the first quarter to March 31, 1997, increased by 43 percent to 46.5 million stg from 32.5 million stg in the same period of 1996.
The company said in a statement that the net loss for the first quarter of 1997 under UK GAAP improved to 19.6 million stg from a net loss of 20.1 million stg in the same period last year.
The company merged last month with the Cable & Wireless Communications (CWC) group to become Britain's biggest cable company.
"I am delighted that the past several months of intense activity has resulted in the successful merger," president and chief executive officer John Killian said in a statement.

"The first quarter has in previous years been difficult, so I am very pleased with the penetration at March 31 and particularly pleased with the reduction in churn achieved with greater acceptance of our services," he added.

The company said the churn rate -- cancelled subscriptions -- for its residential telephony business was down to 16.3 percent from 17.8 percent in March 1996, while the churn rate for its cable television was down to 27.2 percent from 30.1 percent in March 1996.

For residential telephony, the company's penetration rose to 24.0 percent from 21.3 percent in March 1996, while basic penetration for its cable television increased to 18.1 percent from 16.8 percent in March last year.
The company its business telephony lines increased by 117 percent to 39,343 from a March 1996 figure of 18,166.
